title: Noninvasive AI-based system translates brain signals into written text
source: Tech Xplore (Meta AI, Universite PSL & Rothschild Foundation Hospital)
excerpt: Researchers at Meta AI, Universite PSL and the Rothschild Foundation Hospital introduced a noninvasive brain-activity-to-text approach that decodes language from brain signals without surgery, a step toward accessible brain-computer interfaces.

title: Is AI Reasoning Right for the Wrong Reasons?
excerpt: The idea that AI can 'reason' is more intuitive than ever, but the science is far from settled; researchers probe whether models reason or merely appear to.

title: Clinical chatbots are taking medicine by storm. Should doctors trust them?
source: STAT News (NYU Langone Health, Nature Medicine)
excerpt: A Nature Medicine study from NYU Langone Health tested general vs. specialized clinical AI models on clinical questions, finding specialized clinical AI performed worse than general models.

title: AI tool predicts how DNA sequences switch on genes across different cell types
excerpt: Max Planck researchers built Corgi (Context-aware Regulatory Genomics Inference), a deep-learning tool that predicts how the genome behaves and switches on genes across different cell types.

title: Two research efforts gave AI the same open problem. Their papers were submitted three hours apart
excerpt: An MIT PhD student and two UC cryptographers used GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra in different ways to solve the same open cryptography problem, raising new questions about independent discovery and scientific credit.
